text.tspan: Page 10, chapter 2 begins
What the pen says, word for word, and what it means
THE FIRST PAGES SELL THE BOOK
“yes but I think this should be about the
[struck] READER → the [ZX founder]”
The opening wonder ('I discover things I can do') should
be about the reader, the ZX founder, not about Dinis.
THE VOICE IS MINE
“let's tell this story in my name since I
also felt like this”
Drop the unnamed woman on a podcast: tell the feeling as
Dinis's own, since he felt it too.
THE VOICE IS MINE
“yeah can't find it”
The answer to For Dinis: the podcast cannot be found.
THE MAKING-OF OUT OF THE READER'S WAY
“this book history is not relevant in page
How the first edition started, the logos slide, the zone
and Start with why are history: not for page 10.
WHAT WORKS, KEEP IT
“Now we are getting there :)”
'Whoever is reading this in 2026 or 2027 is ridiculously
privileged' is where the chapter should start.
TOPICS FIRST, DETAILS UNDER THEM
“the fact that I tried to read is not
relevant”
That Dinis tried to read the Business Insider essay, and
hit the paywall, is not for the reader.
